input: uav-07 preflight 6am. batt 92%, props checked no chips, gps 14 sats locked, compass calibrated ok, motors spin smooth. wind 8 km/h fine. good to go
AERO-2: battery at 24 percent, everything else looks fine (props ok, motors ok, gps lock ok, compass ok). Weather clear.
pre-flt Q4-ALPHA. prop #3 has a nick on leading edge. batt 88. gps fine. didnt check compass. motors ok. light drizzle but within limits
UAV-12 checks done. compass interference warning near the truck, moved 10m and it cleared -> ok. GPS 3D fix. batt 100%. props + motors good. gusts 45 km/h, above our 35 limit.
hexa H6-01: motor 4 making grinding noise on spin up. battery 76%. props fine. no gps check yet. compass ok. calm sky
uav-03 all green. 95% pack, props/motors/gps/compass ok, sunny low wind
UAV-09 - battery 31%, props ok motors ok GPS ok compass ok, overcast but flyable
MAPPER-5 prefl: gps only 4 sats no lock after 5 min. batt 90. compass ok. motors ok. props ok. clear.
fpv rig FPV-2 quick check: props swapped new, battery 4S at 85 percent, motors fine. compass/gps not checked (indoor gym). indoor so weather ok
UAV-07 second sortie. batt 67%, props ok. motors warm but normal. gps ok compass ok. light rain started, ops manual says no rain flying
AERO-2 2nd attempt: swapped to fresh pack 98%. props ok, motors ok, gps ok, compass ok. clear skies
Q4-ALPHA prop replaced, props ok now. batt 86%. compass calibration failed twice. gps ok, motors ok, wind ok
uav-15 checklist: battery ?? forgot to note. props ok motors ok gps locked compass ok. weather good
SURVEY-1 pre: batt 72, props ok, motors ok, gps ok, compass ok, mild haze but visibility 3 km so weather fine
H6-01 after motor swap: motor 4 replaced, all motors spin clean. batt 93%. props ok. gps ok. compass ok. weather fine
uav-21: thunderstorm warning in area. didn't do the rest of the checklist. battery 80
MAPPER-5 batt 55% props ok gps 18 sats ok compass ok motors ok, wind 12kmh fine
UAV-09 battery 18% low. props ok. skipped other checks.
FPV-2: bent prop on front left, battery 90%, motors ok. weather fine.
UAV-12 preflight: batt 64, props ok, motor 2 vibration high on test hover, gps ok, compass ok, clear skies
UAV-07 after landing: one prop tip chipped ~2mm. no vibration noticed in flight.
AERO-2 battery pack B3 puffed up a bit after charge, smells weird
Q4-ALPHA camera footage has jello, gimbal seems unbalanced
UAV-12 small scratch on top shell from transport case, cosmetic
H6-01 motor 4 got hot and stopped mid-flight, landed on 5 motors
MAPPER-5 lost RC link for 4 seconds at 600m, RTH failsafe kicked in
UAV-03 hairline crack at base of rear right arm spotted during cleaning
FPV-2 ESC smelled burnt after punch out, video still fine
UAV-09 compass error popped twice mid-mission, toilet bowling
SURVEY-1 camera lens dirty, dust spots on images
UAV-15 landing gear leg loose and wobbles, one screw missing
UAV-21 gps glitch warnings on and off during survey, position hold mostly ok
MAPPER-5 battery cell imbalance 0.05V after flight, otherwise fine
Q4-ALPHA flight controller rebooted in the air!!! dropped 3m then recovered
UAV-07 gimbal ribbon cable worn, camera image cuts out sometimes
AERO-2 sticker peeling off arm
Which aircraft are currently grounded?
context:
2026-11-02 UAV-07: prop tip chipped, replaced with spare prop set P-14. Cleared to fly.
2026-11-03 H6-01: motor 4 overheated and stopped in flight; motor replaced, test hover ok. Cleared to fly.
2026-11-04 AERO-2: battery pack B3 swollen; pack quarantined in fire-safe bag. Aircraft OK with other packs.
2026-11-04 Q4-ALPHA: flight controller rebooted in flight. GROUNDED pending FC replacement.
2026-11-05 MAPPER-5: RC link loss 4 s at 600 m, RTH triggered. Antenna re-seated. GROUNDED until range test passes.
2026-11-05 UAV-12: scratch on top shell. Cosmetic, no action.
